subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Packet-scope grouping of shared runtime helper objects for vehicle physics and collision: suspension spring/damper coefficient curves and clamped accumulators, rigid-body force/torque accumulation into body force buffers, spatial-tree and SAT intersection geometry helpers, trig-table lookup, and small mixed-precision record helpers. The grouping follows the wave scope; it is not evidence that these functions form a single proven subsystem.

summary: Twenty-three functions reconstruct shared runtime computation objects used by the F1C vehicle physics and collision paths. A cluster of suspension/spring functions (PiecewiseFunctionEval 0x00436610, DeltaUpdateTracking 0x0043BB00, QuadFunctionEval 0x0043BB30, QuadraticForceTorqueCalculator 0x0043BB80, SpringDamperCompute 0x0043BBD0, ClampedSpringIntegrator 0x0043E980, DoubleAccumulatorClamp 0x0043EA70) reads and writes overlapping coefficient/accumulator regions of a large per-vehicle state object; a rigid-body cluster (AccumulateAngularImpulse 0x0043E5D0, VelocityDampingFromSpeedError 0x00441AD0, RigidBodyTorqueAccumulation 0x00441BB0, ApplyForceTorqueToRigidBody 0x00441F00, ComputeDamperSpringAndAntiRollForces 0x004432F0, GetBodyMotionState 0x00447100) accumulates forces/torques into body force buffers reachable through this+0x15F0/0x1D4 and reads shared per-vehicle state through this+0x1F00. A geometry/collision cluster (TrigTableLookup 0x00447AB0, Vec3Subtract 0x004484C0, SquaredMagnitudeMixedPrecision 0x004484F0, SpatialTreeInsertion 0x004485D0, DynamicsBVHNodeRecursiveTraversal 0x00448E50, SmallStructCopy 0x00448EC0, TriangleEdgeHalfPlaneComputation 0x00448F00, SATSeparatingAxisTest 0x00448FC0, SegmentIntersection2DTest 0x00449000, VisibilityFrustumTest 0x0044A170) provides trig lookup, mixed-precision vertex records, a 96-byte-node spatial tree, and SAT edge/plane/segment intersection helpers consumed by SATEdgeSeparationTest and TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder. Only ClampedSpringIntegrator has a named DERIVED owner from the packet; all other owners are UNKNOWN, and the single-owner class grouping below is a DERIVED/GUESS proposal.

function_roles.role: Evaluate a two-input piecewise response curve: a3 selects one of three linear segments by sign and threshold, a2 scales the segment result, and a boundary-excess correction pair applies when a2 falls outside the [lower,upper] window.
Per-frame delta accumulator: store incoming value, scale the frame delta by a smoothing factor, and accumulate it on the frame path.
Evaluate two quadratic curves a*x^2+b*x+c from per-curve coefficient triples and write both results plus the input back to the state object.
Store the input value and evaluate two quadratics into force/torque output slots (interpreted, DERIVED) for a vehicle dynamics evaluation.
Evaluate three linear curves y = a2*slope + intercept from per-curve coefficient pairs and write results to the three output slots.

Accumulate a contact impulse and the cross-product torque it produces around the contact point into the state's impulse and torque triples, then forward both to the shared collision-impulse accumulator.
Integrate two spring accumulator slots with fixed rates, clamp each into a window around its reference, and dispatch spring/damper curve evaluation.
Accumulate a scaled input into the clamp accumulator and clamp it into the window derived from a reference field.
Compute an aerodynamic velocity-damping force from the body speed error, guarded by shared-state enable/mode flags and a global flag, and accumulate it into the body force buffer.
Accumulate a torque-like contribution between the source body and the target body: rotate a local vector, form a lever arm, scale by body/state parameters, and add into the target body force buffer.
Apply per-wheel force/torque through a 3x4 inertia-tensor matrix into the four wheel-slot output vectors, gated by an active byte.

Per-corner suspension and anti-roll bar force computation for one axle: clamp travel averages, write damper force, solve 6x6 couplings, accumulate torque into the chassis body, optional helper-spring abutment force, wheel-ground contact solves, and two anti-roll bar coupling blocks.
Query accessor: compute suspension spring/damper force and torque into two result vectors and copy them into the caller-supplied output arrays.
Linear-interpolated lookup into a 256-entry single-precision trig table using a scaled, byte-wrapped table index.
Element-wise subtract of two mixed-precision 16-byte records (float/double/float), writing into this and returning the source pointer.
Squared magnitude of a mixed-precision three-component record (float/double/float) as the sum of squared components.
Insert or locate a node in a 96-byte-node spatial tree keyed by (float, double, float), allocating new nodes and descending chain/branch slots.
Recursive traversal of a dynamics BVH node chain: process the linked-list payload, recurse into four child slots, and advance through the sibling pointer.
Copy a collision-body type byte and handle word pair into this during collision-body initialization.
Compute inward-facing half-plane (nx, ny, d) coefficient triples for all three triangle edges with a small outward bias, into the caller's output buffer.
Test a point against consecutive half-plane coefficient triples beginning at a1+0x10; true only when the point lies beyond all three planes.
2D line-segment intersection test over four point triples with endpoint-sharing/vertical/parallel rejection and an endpoint skin tolerance.
Compute a coverage/overlap metric between two vertex batches into a this-side accumulator, with optional vertex chain linking.

classes.name: VehiclePhysicsState
classes.responsibility: Large per-vehicle physics state object: suspension/spring coefficient region, damper force output, clamp accumulators, per-wheel solver buffers, shared-state pointer (this+0x1F00), body pointer (this+0x15F0), target body pointer (this+0x1D4), and impulse/torque accumulation triples. Assumed owner of the suspension and rigid-body force evaluation methods; the single-owner grouping is DERIVED, not proven by the packet.

classes.name: ClampedSpringIntegrator
classes.responsibility: Named DERIVED owner of 0x0043E980 from the packet: integrates two spring accumulator slots with fixed rates and clamps each into a window around a reference, then dispatches spring/damper curve evaluation via SpringDamperCompute. Operates on the same suspension coefficient region as VehiclePhysicsState; whether it is a distinct object or a component view of the same state object is unresolved.

classes.name: PiecewiseResponseCurve
classes.responsibility: GUESS owner of 0x00436610: a two-input piecewise response curve built from fifteen coefficient fields (three sign/threshold-selected linear segments plus a boundary correction pair). Interpreted per existing analysis as a spring/damper response curve; the class identity is not proven by the packet.

classes.name: RigidBody
classes.responsibility: Rigid-body object reached through VehiclePhysicsState.bodyPtr (this+0x15F0) and VehiclePhysicsState.targetBodyPtr (this+0x1D4): position, orientation matrix, velocity, and the force/angular-momentum accumulators that force producers write into. Layout beyond the evidenced fields is not confirmed.

classes.name: SharedVehicleState
classes.responsibility: Shared per-vehicle state reached through VehiclePhysicsState.sharedStatePtr (this+0x1F00): suspension enable/mode flags, wheel contact point, and front/rear linked-object pointers used by the anti-roll bar guards.

classes.name: TriangleVertexRecord
classes.responsibility: GUESS owner of the mixed-precision 16-byte record used by the collision triangle-edge subdivision helpers: float at +0x0, double at +0x4, float at +0xC. The single-owner grouping of the two helpers is a proposal, not proven.

classes.name: SpatialTreeNode
classes.responsibility: GUESS owner of the 96-byte-node spatial-tree insertion and the BVH node-chain traversal: key fields (float +0, double +4, float +0xC), a four-way child region beginning at +0x4C, and a chain/sibling pointer at +0x5C. The child-slot versus branch-slot layout at +0x4C..+0x58 is ambiguous and may represent two different node types.

classes.name: CollisionBody
classes.responsibility: GUESS owner of the collision-body initialization pair written by SmallStructCopy: a body-type byte at +0x19 and a handle/index word at +0x1A. The owning collision-body class is not evidenced beyond these two fields.

classes.name: SATCollisionHelpers
classes.responsibility: GUESS owner of the SAT edge-separation geometry helpers consumed by SATEdgeSeparationTest: half-plane computation for triangle edges, point-vs-plane-triple testing, and 2D segment intersection. The class grouping is a proposal; the helpers may be free functions.

interfaces.name: SpatialTree
interfaces.purpose: Insertion and traversal of a 96-byte-node spatial tree keyed by (float, double, float), with a four-way child region at +0x4C and a chain/sibling pointer at +0x5C. New nodes are allocated through OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and initialized by QuaternionRotationStructureInitialize.

interfaces.name: RigidBodyForceAccumulator
interfaces.purpose: Contract for producers that accumulate forces/torques into a rigid body's force buffer (+0x134/+0x13C/+0x144) and angular-momentum fields (+0x14C/+0x154/+0x15C).

interfaces.name: SuspensionCurveEvaluator
interfaces.purpose: Evaluate polynomial/linear coefficient curves defined on the suspension state object and write results into its output slots; a shared interface over the curve-evaluator methods.

compatibility_contracts.name: SpatialTree96ByteNodeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Spatial-tree nodes are 96 bytes with keys at +0x0 (float), +0x4 (double) and +0xC (float), a four-way child region at +0x4C..+0x58, and a chain/sibling pointer at +0x5C. Insertion allocates new nodes of this size via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper.

compatibility_contracts.name: RigidBodyAccumulatorOffsets
compatibility_contracts.description: A rigid body exposes its accumulated force at +0x134/+0x13C/+0x144 and its angular-momentum accumulator at +0x14C/+0x154/+0x15C; force/torque producers (damping, coupling torque, anti-roll bars) must write these offsets. The same +0x134/+0x13C/+0x144 force offsets are used for both the source body (this+0x15F0) and the target body (this+0x1D4).

compatibility_contracts.name: MixedPrecisionVertexRecordLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Triangle collision-edge records are 16 bytes: float at +0x0, double at +0x4, float at +0xC. Subtraction and squared-magnitude helpers operate on this layout; collision-mesh edge subdivision consumes them.

compatibility_contracts.name: TrigTable256Layout
compatibility_contracts.description: A 256-entry single-precision table at 0x8AAE74 is indexed with byte wrap and linear interpolation; the input double is scaled by 4.0 minus 0.5 before the byte index truncation.

unresolved: Single-owner grouping of the suspension/rigid-body functions into VehiclePhysicsState is DERIVED; the packet does not prove that one class owns all of them, and most packet owners are UNKNOWN.

ClampedSpringIntegrator and VehiclePhysicsState share the suspension coefficient region (0x1808, 0x1818, 0x1C18, 0x1C28); the packet's evidence that ClampedSpringIntegrator calls SpringDamperCompute with the same this object supports common ownership of that region but does not resolve whether they are one object or a component view.

Offset 0x48 is read as a direction scalar by VelocityDampingFromSpeedError and as a correction-line intercept by PiecewiseFunctionEval. These are kept as separate fields on different (hypothetical) classes and are not merged.

The spatial-tree node slots 0x4C..0x58 are branch slots under computed indexing in SpatialTreeInsertion but a fixed four-child region in DynamicsBVHNodeRecursiveTraversal; whether these are two node types or one layout is unresolved.
RigidBody and SharedVehicleState layouts beyond the evidenced fields (e.g. the full orientation matrix rows +0x1C..+0x5C, contact struct at this+0x15F0) are not confirmed.
ApplyForceTorqueToRigidBody's per-slot velocity sources at v7[716..718] and the term at this + 8*(index+1) + 5920 have no dedicated field evidence refs and are grounded in raw source only.

The per-constant pairing of module double globals is unresolved: 0x0059EB28/0x0059EB50/0x0059EB58/0x0059EC78 to the 0.23/0.18 rates and 0.25/0.2 clamps in ClampedSpringIntegrator; 0x0059E430/0x0059ED40/0x0059ED48 to the 8.0 reference speed and 93.75 gain in VelocityDampingFromSpeedError; 0x0059EC80/0x0059EC88 to the 0.37/0.4 constants in DoubleAccumulatorClamp.

Globals listed as read by the deterministic fact table but absent from the raw decompiled body: 0x007CBB10 (AccumulateAngularImpulse), 0x0059EC80 and 0x0059EC88 (DoubleAccumulatorClamp), 0x0059E440 (ApplyForceTorqueToRigidBody, flt_59E440), 0x0059E7D8 and 0x0059E880 (TrigTableLookup), 0x0059E43C and 0x0059E440 (VisibilityFrustumTest), 0x0059E420/0x0059E430/0x0059E880 (ComputeDamperSpringAndAntiRollForces). Their roles are unknown.
Fields *(this+0x1F00)+0xD14 and +0xD58 are read per the fact table but absent from the decompiled body of ComputeDamperSpringAndAntiRollForces; their role in suspension/ARB state is unknown.
Whether the anti-roll-bar linked-object null/flag guards mean 'no linked car' or 'linked car ready' is ambiguous.

The force/torque interpretation of QuadraticForceTorqueCalculator outputs and the spring/damper curve semantics of SpringDamperCompute and the helper-spring block are DERIVED from prose, not proven by packet arithmetic alone.
TrigTableLookup and VisibilityFrustumTest have no defensible owning class in the packet; they are modeled as free helpers with UNKNOWN owners.
The exact component mapping of triangle vertices to x/z in TriangleEdgeHalfPlaneComputation and the role of the 0.001 normal-length bias (plane thickness vs edge tolerance) are inferred, not stated.
